properties.comment: Sioux Valley Energy has planned power outage information for you. Line workers will be working in your area, in Hills, this afternoon, for emergency work on a pole. Your power will be off around 3:30pm for approximately 3 hours. If you have any questions please call dispatch at 1 800 234 1960, Thank you.
